rationale: Power intent is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL21 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

low_power_modes_summary.bus_idle_static_power: Both SDA and SCL HIGH (released). Only Rp leakage current per VDD/Rp.
low_power_modes_summary.device_sleep_release: Sleeping devices must release SDA and SCL (HIGH-Z).
low_power_modes_summary.wakeup_response_window: Device must respond to its address within tACK at the prevailing bus speed.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning is deferred to SoC integration. Mixed-VDD I2C is supported via voltage-level translators or by pulling Rp to the highest VDD on the bus and ensuring all devices tolerate that level.
